description: Read the app's permissions as the Permissions tool (@buoy-gg/permissions) sees them: each permission the app can reach (location, camera, notifications, photos…), what the OS says, any override, which libraries asked (Expo modules, PermissionsAndroid, react-native-permissions), the states this platform allows, and the recent permission calls with what each one returned. Check this before calling a permission screen, prompt or Settings flow a bug.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

logLimit.description: How many recent calls to list. Default 12.

name: get_permissions
